label: SaaS landing page: single page plan with proof numbers and a trial CTA
instruction: Build me one landing page for Ledgerline, a bookkeeping reconciliation tool for small finance teams. It should explain what it does, why it is trustworthy, and push people to a free trial.

page.audience: finance managers at companies of 20 to 200 people

response.summary: A single landing page for a reconciliation product: hero with proof numbers, three capabilities, a positioning statement and a trial call to action.

content.headline: Close The Books By Tuesday
content.body: Ledgerline matches every transaction against your bank feed overnight, so month end is a review rather than a rebuild. Built for finance teams of three to thirty.

content.headline: Three Jobs, One Evening
content.item1Body: Bank feeds, invoices and expenses are reconciled overnight against rules your team writes in plain language.
content.item2Body: Only the transactions that need a human reach a person, ranked by value and by how long they have been open.
content.item3Body: Every match, override and approval is recorded with who did it and why, exported to your accountant in one file.

content.eyebrow: 03. Why it is built this way
content.headline: Software Should Not Guess
content.body: Reconciliation tools that guess quietly are worse than doing it by hand, because nobody finds the error until the audit. Ledgerline never merges a transaction it cannot justify.
content.bodySecondary: Every automatic decision shows the rule that produced it, and any rule can be turned off by the person it inconveniences. Confidence comes from being able to check.

content.headline: See it on your own ledger
content.body: Connect a read-only bank feed and Ledgerline will reconcile last month overnight. No card, no sales call, cancel in one click.
